يحتفرون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَفِرُونَ (yaḥtafirūna) /jaħ.ta.fi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# يُحْتَفَرُونَ (yuḥtafarūna) /juħ.ta.fa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
